title: 十二怒汉
creator: Sidney Lumet
note: 一间屋、十二把椅子、一场关于合理怀疑的陪审团辩论——单场景电影的天花板。
noteEn: One room, twelve men, one argument for reasonable doubt — the ceiling of single-set cinema.

title: 教父
creator: Francis Ford Coppola
note: 家族即系统：忠诚、背叛与权力继承的黑帮史诗，奠定了整个帮派片语法的地基。
noteEn: The family as a system: an epic of loyalty, betrayal and succession that built the mafia-film grammar.

title: 教父2
creator: Francis Ford Coppola
note: 双线交叉剪辑把移民血泪与家族崩塌并置，续集比肩原作的罕见样本。
noteEn: Dual timelines braid an immigrant's rise against a family's fall — the rare sequel that rivals the original.

title: 霸王别姬
creator: 陈凯歌
note: 戏梦人生半个世纪，把京剧国粹、性别与政治悲剧熔进一炉的华语巅峰。
noteEn: Half a century of opera, love and political tragedy — the pinnacle of Chinese-language cinema.

title: 活着
creator: 张艺谋
note: 一个家庭在时代洪流里反复失去，活着的意义被逼到只剩「活着」。
noteEn: A family stripped of everything by history, until meaning is reduced to survival itself.

title: 肖申克的救赎
creator: Frank Darabont
note: 希望是好的，也许是世上最好的东西——体制化的温柔反叛。
noteEn: Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things — a gentle rebellion against the system.

title: 阿甘正传
creator: Robert Zemeckis
note: 用一颗纯真的心穿过美国半个世纪的乱流，笨拙本身就是一种幸运。
noteEn: Running on innocence through half a century of American chaos — simplicity as luck.

title: 让子弹飞
creator: 姜文
note: 枪声一响、隐喻满场，张麻子与黄四郎的对弈是讲不尽的寓言。
noteEn: Bullets flying, allegory everywhere — Zhang's duel with Huang is an inexhaustible fable.

title: 飞越疯人院
en: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
creator: Milos Forman
note: 麦克墨菲撞上制度化的疯人院，自由与秩序的角力至今没有结局。
noteEn: A free spirit collides with an institution — the contest between freedom and order never ends.

title: 出租车司机
creator: Martin Scorsese
note: 越战老兵特拉维斯在午夜纽约的孤独与愤怒，「你在跟我说话吗」成为影史独白。
noteEn: Travis's loneliness and rage in a midnight New York; De Niro's "You talkin' to me?" is screen legend.

title: 死亡诗社
creator: Peter Weir
note: 「及时行乐」的基廷老师教学生站在课桌上换一种眼光看世界，代价是青春的觉醒与断裂。
noteEn: Carpe diem — Keating makes his boys stand on desks to see the world anew, at the cost of their awakening.

title: 心灵捕手
creator: Gus Van Sant
note: 天才清洁工与老心理师互相拯救，「这不是你的错」是一场迟到的自我赦免。
noteEn: A janitor-genius and his shrink rescue each other; "It's not your fault" becomes a late absolution.

title: 美国丽人
creator: Sam Mendes
note: 中产郊区的假象被一袋塑料袋和青春期欲望戳破，美国梦的背面是虚无。
noteEn: Suburban facades collapse under a drifting plastic bag and teenage desire — the American Dream's hollow reverse.

title: 搏击俱乐部
creator: David Fincher
note: 被消费主义规训的失眠者用拳头找回痛感，第一诫：不许谈论搏击俱乐部。
noteEn: An insomniac regains feeling through fists; first rule: you do not talk about Fight Club.

title: 暖暖内含光
en: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
creator: Michel Gondry
note: 把一段爱情从记忆里逐格删除时，才看见自己有多舍不得——科幻外壳下的心碎寓言。
noteEn: Deleting a love memory by memory reveals how much you wanted to keep it — a heartbreak dressed as sci-fi.

title: 断背山
creator: Ang Lee
note: 两个牛仔把一生藏在断背山里，李安用克制拍出旷野般无边的遗憾。
noteEn: Two cowboys hide a lifetime on Brokeback Mountain; Ang Lee films regret as vast as the range.

title: 血色将至
creator: Paul Thomas Anderson
note: 石油大亨把贪婪、信仰与父爱全部烧进油井，「我喝光了你的奶昔」是资本主义的墓志铭。
noteEn: Daniel's greed consumes faith and fatherhood in the oil fields; "I drink your milkshake" is capitalism's epitaph.

title: 老无所依
creator: Joel & Ethan Coen
note: 冷面杀手用硬币决定生死，老警长输给了时代——恶不再需要理由。
noteEn: A coin flip decides life and death; the old sheriff loses to an age where evil needs no reason.

title: 月光男孩
creator: Barry Jenkins
note: 三段式描摹黑人男孩的成长、身份与爱，海边的蓝是温柔也是枷锁。
noteEn: Three acts of a Black boy's coming of age — the blue by the sea is both tenderness and a cage.

title: 海边的曼彻斯特
creator: Kenneth Lonergan
note: 失去孩子的父亲拒绝和解，悲伤不一定要被治愈——它只是被携带着活下去。
noteEn: A grieving father refuses closure; sorrow need not heal — only be carried on.

title: 瞬息全宇宙
creator: Daniel Kwan & Daniel Scheinert
note: 用多元宇宙的疯狂想象讲华裔母亲的母女关系，报税单上的家庭也能拯救所有宇宙。
noteEn: Multiverse madness as a Chinese-American mother-daughter story — even a laundromat family saves every universe.

title: 花样年华
creator: Wong Kar-wai
note: 旗袍与领带在窄巷擦肩，欲言又止的婚外情被拍成一场关于时间的雾。
noteEn: Cheongsams and ties graze in alleys; an affair never spoken aloud becomes a fog of time.

title: 重庆森林
creator: Wong Kar-wai
note: 过期凤梨罐头与午夜梦游人，王家卫把都市孤独拍得既甜又酸。
noteEn: Expired pineapple cans and midnight sleepwalkers — Wong Kar-wai films urban loneliness sweet and sour.

title: 牯岭街少年杀人事件
creator: Edward Yang
note: 近四小时的少年史诗，小四的一刀既刺向爱人，也刺向整个时代的压抑。
noteEn: A four-hour youth epic — Xiao Si's knife strikes both his love and the repression of an era.

title: 一一
creator: Edward Yang
note: 婚礼、怀孕、葬礼串联三代人的中年困局，「我们是不是只能看到一半的事情？」
noteEn: Wedding, birth and funeral braid three generations; "Can we only see half of things?"

title: 东京物语
creator: Yasujirō Ozu
note: 老夫妇进城看望子女却遭冷落，小津用低机位和静默拍出亲情最温柔的残酷。
noteEn: Elderly parents visit indifferent children; Ozu's low angles and silence make family love gently cruel.

title: 小偷家族
creator: Hirokazu Kore-eda
note: 没有血缘的一家人靠偷窃维生，却比许多家庭更接近「家」的定义。
noteEn: A family bound not by blood but by shoplifting — closer to "family" than most real ones.

title: 入殓师
creator: Yōjirō Takita
note: 把为逝者整理仪容拍成温柔仪式，入殓师让生者与死者都体面告别。
noteEn: Preparing the dead becomes a tender ritual — a way for the living to say farewell with dignity.

title: 寄生虫
creator: Bong Joon-ho
note: 地下室与豪宅之间只隔一段楼梯，奉俊昊的阶级寓言在暴雨夜轰然崩塌。
noteEn: A basement and a mansion, one staircase apart — Bong's class fable collapses on a stormy night.

title: 燃烧
creator: Lee Chang-dong
note: 消失的女孩与温室之谜，李沧东把村上春树的短篇改写成当代韩国的愤怒与虚无。
noteEn: A missing girl and vanishing greenhouses — Lee turns Murakami's short story into Korean rage and void.

title: 老男孩
creator: Park Chan-wook
note: 被囚禁十五年的男人走出密室，走廊群殴与生吃章鱼都是复仇的仪式。
noteEn: Fifteen years locked in a room — the corridor brawl and live octopus are rituals of revenge.

title: 大地之歌
creator: Satyajit Ray
note: 印度乡村孩童阿普的贫苦童年，雷伊的自然主义让第三世界电影登上世界舞台。
noteEn: Apu's impoverished rural childhood; Ray's naturalism put Third World cinema on the world stage.

title: 偷自行车的人
creator: Vittorio De Sica
note: 失业父亲带着儿子满城找一辆被偷的自行车，新现实主义的眼泪至今未干。
noteEn: An unemployed father and son hunt one stolen bicycle — neorealism's tears never dried.

title: 甜蜜的生活
creator: Federico Fellini
note: 罗马夜生活的狗仔与明星们，费里尼让「甜蜜生活」变成一具华丽的空壳。
noteEn: Paparazzi and starlets in Rome's nightlife — Fellini renders "la dolce vita" a gilded void.

title: 八部半
creator: Federico Fellini
note: 灵感枯竭的导演在梦与现实之间打转，费里尼把创作焦虑拍成电影自反性的教科书。
noteEn: A blocked director floats between dream and reality — Fellini's textbook of cinematic self-reflection.

title: 天堂电影院
creator: Giuseppe Tornatore
note: 胶片与初恋一起被剪辑成回望，结尾那卷亲吻合集是写给电影的情书。
noteEn: Film reels and first love spliced into memory; the closing kiss-reel is a love letter to cinema.

title: 爱
creator: Michael Haneke
note: 一对老夫妻直面衰老与死亡的每一帧都克制到残忍，爱到尽头是慈悲也是责任。
noteEn: Every frame of an elderly couple facing decay is cruel restraint — love's end is mercy and duty.

title: 怒火青春
creator: Mathieu Kassovitz
note: 巴黎郊区三个青年在骚乱夜游荡，黑白影像里「这世界属于你们」满是火药味。
noteEn: Three youths roam a riot-torn Paris suburb; "This world belongs to you" rings with gunpowder.

title: 窃听风暴
creator: Florian Henckel von Donnersmarck
note: 东德秘密警察从监听者变成守护者，一个人的良知照亮了整部极权机器。
noteEn: A Stasi agent turns from listener to guardian — one conscience lights up an entire apparatus.

title: 冷战
creator: Paweł Pawlikowski
note: 铁幕两侧分合二十年的恋人，黑白胶片与一首歌贯穿冷战年代的流亡。
noteEn: Lovers split and reunite across the Iron Curtain; a song threads through two decades of exile.

title: 第七封印
creator: Ingmar Bergman
note: 骑士与死神对弈拖延审判，瘟疫时代的人追问上帝为何沉默。
noteEn: A knight plays chess with Death; a plague-torn age asks why God is silent.

title: 上帝之城
creator: Fernando Meirelles
note: 里约贫民窟的孩子在枪口下长大，快剪与狂欢把暴力拍成一部残酷青春史诗。
noteEn: Kids grow up at gunpoint in a Rio favela — frenzied editing turns violence into a brutal youth epic.

title: 中央车站
creator: Walter Salles
note: 代写书信的老妇与寻父男孩踏上巴西腹地之旅，两个孤独的灵魂彼此缝合。
noteEn: A letter-writing old woman and a fatherless boy cross the Brazilian heartland, mending each other.

title: 罗马
creator: Alfonso Cuarón
note: 黑白镜头凝视墨西哥城一个中产家庭与女佣，卡隆把私人记忆拍成时代的涟漪。
noteEn: A monochrome gaze on a Mexico City household and its maid — Cuarón turns memory into an era's ripple.

title: 荒蛮故事
creator: Damián Szifrón
note: 六个失控的复仇小故事，从婚礼到公路，文明随时准备被撕成碎片。
noteEn: Six stories of rage snapping — from wedding to highway, civilization is a bomb waiting to go off.

title: 辛德勒的名单
creator: Steven Spielberg
note: 黑白影像里那一点红衣，是人性在灰烬中仍未被抹去的证据。
noteEn: A single red coat in a world of black and white — proof that humanity survived the ashes.

title: 末代皇帝
creator: Bernardo Bertolucci
note: 紫禁城实景拍摄，把一个囚徒皇帝的一生拍成东方与西方眼光的对话。
noteEn: Shot inside the Forbidden City, a captive emperor's life becomes a dialogue between East and West.

title: 模仿游戏
creator: Morten Tyldum
note: 图灵破译恩尼格玛的秘密战争，与一个天才被时代辜负的悲剧。
noteEn: Turing's secret war against Enigma — and a genius betrayed by the very system he saved.

title: 至暗时刻
creator: Joe Wright
note: 加里·奥德曼的丘吉尔，把嘴硬、焦虑与绝不投降揉进每一次呼吸。
noteEn: Gary Oldman's Churchill — stubbornness, anxiety and refusal to yield in every breath.

title: 阿拉伯的劳伦斯
creator: David Lean
note: 沙漠史诗中一个英国人成为阿拉伯传奇，劳伦斯的自我分裂和沙丘一样辽阔。
noteEn: An Englishman becomes an Arab legend in a desert epic; Lawrence's fractured self is vast as the dunes.

title: 愤怒的公牛
creator: Martin Scorsese
note: 拳王拉莫塔的嫉妒与自毁，黑白拳台成为德尼罗自我惩罚的祭坛。
noteEn: LaMotta's jealousy and self-destruction; the black-and-white ring is De Niro's altar of self-flagellation.

title: 莫扎特传
creator: Miloš Forman
note: 庸才萨列里与天才莫扎特的嫉妒对峙，「上帝选中了莫扎特，却让我在一旁观看」。
noteEn: Mediocre Salieri vs divine Mozart — "God chose Mozart, and left me to watch."

title: 甘地传
creator: Richard Attenborough
note: 本·金斯利化身为「圣雄」，非暴力不合作以八十一年的生命写进历史。
noteEn: Ben Kingsley becomes the Mahatma; a lifetime of non-violence inscribed on history.

title: 马尔科姆 X
creator: Spike Lee
note: 从罪犯到民权领袖再到朝圣者，丹泽尔·华盛顿撑起一部黑人觉醒的编年史。
noteEn: From convict to civil-rights leader to pilgrim; Denzel carries a chronicle of Black awakening.

title: 艾德·伍德
creator: Tim Burton
note: 影史最烂导演的真诚与狂热被伯顿拍成黑白温柔，热爱本身就不输任何天才。
noteEn: Burton films the "worst director ever" with black-and-white tenderness — passion alone rivals genius.

title: 猫鼠游戏
creator: Steven Spielberg
note: 少年骗子与追捕他的探员之间奇妙的亦敌亦友，莱昂纳多把谎言演得闪闪发光。
noteEn: A teen con artist and the agent chasing him — an odd friendship where DiCaprio makes lies shine.

title: 钢琴家
creator: Roman Polanski
note: 波兰钢琴家席皮尔曼在华沙废墟中求生，钢琴声是文明最后的余温。
noteEn: Szpilman survives among Warsaw's ruins; music is civilization's last warmth.

title: 灵魂歌王
creator: Taylor Hackford
note: 杰米·福克斯还原盲眼歌王雷·查尔斯，蓝调与福音在他的生命里打架又和解。
noteEn: Jamie Foxx channels blind Ray Charles — blues and gospel fight and reconcile inside him.

title: 飞行家
creator: Martin Scorsese
note: 霍华德·休斯的飞机制造、好莱坞情史与强迫症，小李子在洁癖里演尽天才的疯狂。
noteEn: Hughes's planes, loves and OCD — DiCaprio turns obsession into the price of genius.

title: 当幸福来敲门
creator: Gabriele Muccino
note: 睡在厕所也要抱着儿子的单亲爸爸，史密斯父子的真实出演让励志有了体温。
noteEn: A homeless dad sleeps in a subway restroom with his son; father-and-son casting makes it warm.

title: 米尔克
creator: Gus Van Sant
note: 首位公开出柜的民选官员哈维·米尔克，西恩·潘把竞选演讲变成平权宣言。
noteEn: Harvey Milk, first openly gay elected official — Penn turns a campaign speech into a rights manifesto.

title: 社交网络
creator: David Fincher
note: 扎克伯格的背叛与诉讼，芬奇把「改变世界」拍成一场冰冷的智力游戏。
noteEn: Zuckerberg's betrayals and lawsuits — Fincher films "changing the world" as a cold mind game.

title: 国王的演讲
creator: Tom Hooper
note: 口吃国王与草根治疗师互相成就，一场演讲治好一个帝国的怯场。
noteEn: A stammering king and an unlicensed therapist lift each other; one speech steadies an empire.

title: 林肯
creator: Steven Spielberg
note: 丹尼尔·戴-刘易斯把林肯还原为疲惫的政治博弈者，废除奴隶制是一场幕后的算计与信念。
noteEn: DDL's Lincoln is a weary political operator; abolishing slavery is backroom math and conviction.

title: 万物理论
creator: James Marsh
note: 霍金的宇宙理论之外，是简·霍金在病床边的坚守，时间对爱情同样无情。
noteEn: Beyond Hawking's cosmos is Jane's vigil at his bedside — time is as cruel to love as to stars.

title: 血战钢锯岭
creator: Mel Gibson
note: 拒绝持枪的军医戴斯蒙德在冲绳救下七十五条命，信仰可以是一个人的战争。
noteEn: A medic who refuses to bear arms saves 75 lives on Okinawa — faith can fight a one-man war.

title: 隐藏人物
creator: Theodore Melfi
note: 三位黑人女数学家把人类送上轨道，办公室里的种族隔离比太空更远。
noteEn: Three Black women mathematicians put humans in orbit — office segregation farther than space.

title: 波西米亚狂想曲
creator: Bryan Singer
note: 拉米·马雷克在 Live Aid 舞台上复刻皇后乐队，弗雷迪的璀璨与孤独同频共振。
noteEn: Rami Malek relives Queen at Live Aid — Freddie's brilliance and loneliness resonate as one.

title: 奥本海默
creator: Christopher Nolan
note: 「现在我成了死神」，诺兰用 IMAX 与黑白听证会拆解原子弹之父的道德十字架。
noteEn: "Now I am become Death" — Nolan's IMAX hearings dissect the father of the bomb's moral cross.

title: 与歌同行
creator: James Mangold
note: 约翰尼·卡什的毒瘾与救赎，瑞茜·威瑟斯彭的琼·卡特让乡村音乐有了灵魂。
noteEn: Cash's addiction and redemption; Witherspoon's June Carter gives country music its soul.

title: 弗里达
creator: Julie Taymor
note: 弗里达·卡罗把疼痛画成画布上的自画像，萨玛·海耶克让生命开成不凋的花。
noteEn: Kahlo's pain blooms as self-portraits; Salma Hayek makes a life that refuses to wilt.

title: 帝国的毁灭
creator: Oliver Hirschbiegel
note: 地堡里希特勒的最后十二天，布鲁诺·甘茨让元首褪去神话、露出人的颤抖。
noteEn: Hitler's last twelve days in the bunker — Ganz strips the Führer of myth, leaving human tremor.

title: 玫瑰人生
creator: Olivier Dahan
note: 玛丽昂·歌迪亚化身为法国小云雀皮雅芙，玫瑰色的人生也是荆棘满身的一生。
noteEn: Cotillard becomes the Little Sparrow Piaf — a life in roses, thorned through and through.

title: 伪钞制造者
creator: Stefan Ruzowitzky
note: 集中营里被逼伪造英镑的犹太匠人，生存的道德底线在流水线上反复烧灼。
noteEn: Jewish forgers forced to print pounds in a camp — survival's ethics burn on the assembly line.

title: 摔跤吧！爸爸
creator: Nitesh Tiwari
note: 阿米尔·汗把女儿们训练成摔跤冠军，一位父亲替她们对抗整个世界，直到她们能自己选择。
noteEn: Aamir Khan turns daughters into wrestlers — a father fights the world so they can choose their own.

title: 摩托日记
creator: Walter Salles
note: 年轻的切·格瓦拉骑摩托穿越拉美大陆，沿途的贫穷把医学生变成革命者。
noteEn: Young Che rides a motorcycle across Latin America; poverty turns a med student into a revolutionary.

title: 阮玲玉
creator: Stanley Kwan
note: 戏中戏与史料交织，张曼玉凭阮玲玉拿下柏林银熊，把默片女星的身前身后揉进光影。
noteEn: Film-within-film meets archival footage; Maggie Cheung's Berlin-winning turn haunts the silent star.

title: 一代宗师
creator: Wong Kar-wai
note: 「见自己、见天地、见众生」，王家卫把咏春宗师叶问拍成一招一式的东方哲学。
noteEn: "See self, see heaven and earth, see all beings" — Wong turns Ip Man into moving Eastern philosophy.

title: 夺冠
creator: Peter Chan
note: 从女排五连冠到里约重夺金，郎平与女排姑娘们把「女排精神」压进每一个扣杀。
noteEn: From five straight titles to Rio's gold — Lang Ping and her team pack "volleyball spirit" into every spike.

title: 出租车司机
creator: Jang Hoon
note: 光州事件的目击者：首尔出租车司机误闯戒严现场，一个人用方向盘载起一段历史。
noteEn: A Seoul taxi driver stumbles into the Gwangju crackdown — one wheeled witness carries history.
